name: IGNITE_LOG_GRID_NAME
description: If this system property is present Ignite will include grid name into  verbose log

name: IGNITE_LOG_INSTANCE_NAME
description: If this system property is present Ignite will include grid name into  verbose log

name: IGNITE_RESTART_CODE
description: If this system property is present Ignite will include instance name  into verbose log

name: IGNITE_NO_SHUTDOWN_HOOK
description: Exit code to pass to loader when Ignite instance is being restarted

name: IGNITE_DISCO_FAILED_CLIENT_RECONNECT_DELAY
description: Reconnect delay in milliseconds for client node that was failed forcible

name: IGNITE_UPDATE_NOTIFIER
description: If this system property is set to false - no checks for new versions will  be performed by Ignite. By default, Ignite periodically checks for the new version and prints out the  message into the log if a new version of Ignite is available for download. Update notifier enabled flag is  a cluster-wide value and determined according to the local setting during the start of the first node in  the cluster. The chosen value will survive the first node shutdown and will override the property value  on all newly joining nodes

name: IGNITE_STARVATION_CHECK_INTERVAL
description: Interval in milliseconds in which Ignite will check thread pool state for starvation.  Zero value will disable checker

name: IGNITE_NO_ASCII
description: Interval in milliseconds in which Ignite will check thread pool state for starvation.  Zero value will disable checker

name: IGNITE_JETTY_HOST
description: If this system property is present (any value) - no ASCII logo will be printed

name: IGNITE_JETTY_PORT
description: Jetty host for REST processor

name: IGNITE_JETTY_LOG_NO_OVERRIDE
description: Jetty local port for REST processor

name: IGNITE_REST_SESSION_TIMEOUT
description: REST session expire time in seconds

name: IGNITE_REST_SECURITY_TOKEN_TIMEOUT
description: REST session expire time in seconds

name: IGNITE_REST_MAX_TASK_RESULTS
description: REST session security token expire time in seconds

name: IGNITE_REST_START_ON_CLIENT
description: Maximum count of task results stored on one node in REST processor

name: IGNITE_NEAR_GET_MAX_REMAPS
description: Maximum number of attempts to remap near get to the same primary node.  Remapping may be needed when topology is changed concurrently with get operation

name: IGNITE_QUIET
description: In quiet mode, only warning and errors are printed into the log additionally to a  shortened version of standard output on the start. Note that if you use ignite.{sh|bat} scripts to start  Ignite they start by default in quiet mode. You can supply -v flag to override it

name: IGNITE_CONSOLE_APPENDER
description: If true (default) and Ignite is launched in verbose mode (see IGNITE_QUIET)  and no console appenders can be found in configuration, then default console appender will be added.  Set this property to false if no appenders should be added

name: IGNITE_EXCHANGE_HISTORY_SIZE
description: If true (default) and Ignite is launched in verbose mode (see IGNITE_QUIET)  and no console appenders can be found in configuration, then default console appender will be added.  Set this property to false if no appenders should be added

name: IGNITE_EXCHANGE_MERGE_DELAY
description: Maximum size for exchange history

name: IGNITE_PROG_NAME
description: Partition map exchange merge delay in milliseconds

name: IGNITE_SUCCESS_FILE
description: Name of command line program

name: IGNITE_LOCAL_HOST
description: Sets a system-wide local IP address or hostname to be  used by Ignite networking components. Once provided, the property overrides all the default local binding  settings for Ignite nodes. Note, that the address can also be changed via  IgniteConfiguration.setLocalHost(String) method. However, this system property has bigger priority and  overrides the settings set via IgniteConfiguration

name: IGNITE_DEP_MODE_OVERRIDE
description: Sets deployment mode configuration parameter. Valid  values for property are: PRIVATE, ISOLATED, SHARED or CONTINUOUS

name: IGNITE_MAX_COMPLETED_TX_COUNT
description: Size of buffer holding completed transaction versions.  Buffer is used to detect duplicate transaction.  In most cases this value is large enough and does not need to be changed

name: IGNITE_SLOW_TX_WARN_TIMEOUT
description: Transactions that take more time, than value of this property (in milliseconds),  will be output to warnings. 0 disables warnings on slow transactions

name: IGNITE_TX_DEADLOCK_DETECTION_MAX_ITERS
description: Maximum number of iterations for deadlock detection procedure.  If value of this property is less then or equal to zero then deadlock detection will be disabled

name: IGNITE_TX_DEADLOCK_DETECTION_TIMEOUT
description: Maximum number of iterations for deadlock detection procedure.  If value of this property is less then or equal to zero then deadlock detection will be disabled

name: IGNITE_PENDING_TX_TRACKER_ENABLED
description: Enables pending transaction tracker.  Affects impact of IGNITE_DISABLE_WAL_DURING_REBALANCING property:  if this property is set,  WAL anyway won't be disabled during rebalancing triggered by baseline topology change

name: IGNITE_OVERRIDE_MCAST_GRP
description: Enables pending transaction tracker.  Affects impact of IGNITE_DISABLE_WAL_DURING_REBALANCING property:  if this property is set,  WAL anyway won't be disabled during rebalancing triggered by baseline topology change

name: IGNITE_REFLECTION_CACHE_SIZE
description: Overrides multicast group taken from configuration. Used for testing purposes

name: IGNITE_JOBS_HISTORY_SIZE
description: Overrides default reflection cache size

name: IGNITE_JOBS_METRICS_CONCURRENCY_LEVEL
description: Job metrics processor property defining concurrency level  for structure holding job metrics snapshots

name: IGNITE_CONFIG_URL
description: Job metrics processor property defining concurrency level  for structure holding job metrics snapshots

name: IGNITE_SSH_HOST
description: Configuration URL

name: IGNITE_ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_COMMAND

name: IGNITE_SSH_USER_NAME

name: IGNITE_PRELOAD_RESEND_TIMEOUT

name: IGNITE_DISABLE_HOSTNAME_VERIFIER

name: IGNITE_MIN_BUFFERED_COMMUNICATION_MSG_CNT

name: IGNITE_ATOMIC_CACHE_DELETE_HISTORY_SIZE

name: IGNITE_CACHE_REMOVED_ENTRIES_TTL

name: IGNITE_TCP_DISCOVERY_ADDRESSES

name: IGNITE_ALLOW_MIXED_CACHE_GROUPS

name: IGNITE_ATOMIC_DEFERRED_ACK_BUFFER_SIZE
description: Allows mixed cache groups

name: IGNITE_ATOMIC_DEFERRED_ACK_TIMEOUT

name: IGNITE_ATOMIC_CACHE_QUEUE_RETRY_TIMEOUT

name: IGNITE_DEFERRED_ONE_PHASE_COMMIT_ACK_REQUEST_BUFFER_SIZE

name: IGNITE_LOG_DIR

name: IGNITE_JCACHE_DEFAULT_ISOLATED
description: Enables CacheManager to start grid with isolated  IP finder when default URL is passed in. This is needed to pass TCK tests which use default URL and  assume isolated cache managers for different class loaders

name: IGNITE_SQL_MERGE_TABLE_MAX_SIZE
description: Maximum number of SQL result rows which can be fetched into a merge table.  If there are less rows than this threshold then multiple passes throw a table will be possible,  otherwise only one pass (e.g. only result streaming is possible)

name: IGNITE_SQL_PARSER_DISABLE_H2_FALLBACK

name: IGNITE_SQL_DISABLE_SYSTEM_VIEWS

name: IGNITE_SQL_UUID_DDL_BYTE_FORMAT

name: IGNITE_AFFINITY_HISTORY_SIZE

name: IGNITE_DISCOVERY_CLIENT_RECONNECT_HISTORY_SIZE

description: Number of cache operation retries in case of topology exceptions

name: IGNITE_H2_INDEXING_CACHE_CLEANUP_PERIOD
description: Period in milliseconds between calls of the SQL  statements cache cleanup task. Cleanup tasks clears cache for terminated threads and for threads which did  not perform SQL queries within timeout configured via IGNITE_H2_INDEXING_CACHE_THREAD_USAGE_TIMEOUT  property

name: IGNITE_H2_INDEXING_CACHE_THREAD_USAGE_TIMEOUT
description: Timeout in milliseconds after which thread's SQL statements cache is cleared  by cleanup task if the thread does not perform any query

name: IGNITE_OVERRIDE_CONSISTENT_ID
description: Consistent ID of Ignite node. Value of the  system property will overwrite matched property IgniteConfiguration.setConsistentId(Serializable)  in configuration

name: IGNITE_IGNORE_LOCAL_HOST_NAME
description: Ignores local address's hostname if IGNITE_LOCAL_HOST is defined  when resolving local node's addresses

name: IGNITE_MAX_INDEX_PAYLOAD_SIZE
description: Maximum payload size in bytes for H2TreeIndex.  0 means that inline index store is disabled

name: IGNITE_REBALANCE_STATISTICS_TIME_INTERVAL

name: IGNITE_TTL_EXPIRE_BATCH_SIZE
description: Time interval for calculating rebalance rate statistics, in milliseconds

name: IGNITE_INDEXING_DISCOVERY_HISTORY_SIZE
description: Indexing discovery history size. Protects from duplicate messages  maintaining the list of IDs of recently arrived discovery messages

name: IGNITE_PREFER_WAL_REBALANCE

description: Threshold of the checkpoint quantity since the last earliest checkpoint map snapshot.  After this thresold is reached, a snapshot of the earliest checkpoint map will be captured

name: IGNITE_OFFHEAP_LOCK_CONCURRENCY_LEVEL
description: Threshold of the checkpoint quantity since the last earliest checkpoint map snapshot.  After this thresold is reached, a snapshot of the earliest checkpoint map will be captured

name: IGNITE_CLUSTER_NAME
description: Ignite cluster name. Defaults to cluster ID

name: IGNITE_CLIENT_CACHE_CHANGE_MESSAGE_TIMEOUT
description: When client cache is started or closed special discovery message is sent  to notify cluster (for example this is needed for ClusterGroup.forCacheNodes(String) API. This timeout  in milliseconds specifies how long to wait after client cache start/close before sending this message. If  during this timeout another client cache changed, these events are combined into single message

name: IGNITE_PARTITION_RELEASE_FUTURE_DUMP_THRESHOLD
description: If a partition release future completion time during an exchange exceeds  this threshold (in milliseconds), the contents of the future will be dumped to the log on exchange.  0 means disabled

name: IGNITE_PARTITION_RELEASE_FUTURE_WARN_LIMIT
description: This property specifies the maximum number of futures that are included into diagnostic  message

name: IGNITE_ENABLE_FORCIBLE_NODE_KILL
description: This property specifies the maximum number of futures that are included into diagnostic  message

name: IGNITE_DATA_STREAMING_EXECUTOR_SERVICE_TASKS_STEALING_THRESHOLD
description: Tasks stealing will be started if tasks queue size per data-streamer thread  exceeds this threshold

name: IGNITE_USE_ASYNC_FILE_IO_FACTORY
description: Tasks stealing will be started if tasks queue size per data-streamer thread  exceeds this threshold

name: IGNITE_OVERRIDE_WRITE_THROTTLING_ENABLED
description: If this property is set, then Ignite will use Async File IO factory by default

name: IGNITE_WAL_SERIALIZER_VERSION
description: Checkpoint throttling policy

name: IGNITE_WAL_SEGMENT_SYNC_TIMEOUT
description: WAL serializer version

name: IGNITE_USE_LEGACY_NODE_COMPARATOR

name: IGNITE_DATA_STORAGE_FOLDER_BY_CONSISTENT_ID
description: Enables usage of the mapped byte buffer

name: IGNITE_JVM_PAUSE_DETECTOR_PRECISION
description: JVM pause detector precision

description: JVM pause detector precision

name: IGNITE_JVM_PAUSE_DETECTOR_LAST_EVENTS_COUNT
description: JVM pause detector threshold

name: IGNITE_THIN_CLIENT_ASYNC_REQUESTS_WAIT_TIMEOUT
description: Timeout in milliseconds that determines how long Ignite will synchronously wait for  asynchronous thin client requests to complete before releasing the thread

name: IGNITE_PDS_MAX_CHECKPOINT_MEMORY_HISTORY_SIZE
description: Number of checkpoint history entries held in memory

name: IGNITE_DIRECT_IO_ENABLED
description: Enables direct IO. Direct IO enabled only if JAR  file with corresponding feature is available in classpath and OS and filesystem settings allows to enable  this mode

name: IGNITE_DELAYED_REPLACED_PAGE_WRITE
description: When set to true (default), pages are written to page store without  holding segment lock (with delay). Because other thread may require exactly the same page to be loaded  from store, reads are protected by locking

name: IGNITE_WAL_FSYNC_WITH_DEDICATED_WORKER
description: When set to true (default), pages are written to page store without  holding segment lock (with delay). Because other thread may require exactly the same page to be loaded  from store, reads are protected by locking

name: IGNITE_LOADED_PAGES_BACKWARD_SHIFT_MAP
description: When set to false, loaded pages implementation is switched to previous  version of implementation, FullPageIdTable. True value enables 'Robin Hood hashing: backward shift  deletion'

name: IGNITE_CHECKPOINT_TRIGGER_ARCHIVE_SIZE_PERCENTAGE
description: When set to false, loaded pages implementation is switched to previous  version of implementation, FullPageIdTable. True value enables 'Robin Hood hashing: backward shift  deletion'

name: IGNITE_THRESHOLD_WAL_ARCHIVE_SIZE_PERCENTAGE
description: Property for setup percentage of WAL archive size to calculate threshold since which  removing of old archive should be started

name: IGNITE_THRESHOLD_WAIT_TIME_NEXT_WAL_SEGMENT
description: Threshold time (in millis) to print warning to log if waiting for next wal  segment took longer than the threshold

name: IGNITE_WAL_COMPRESSOR_WORKER_THREAD_CNT
description: Threshold time (in millis) to print warning to log if waiting for next wal  segment took longer than the threshold

name: IGNITE_READ_LOAD_BALANCING
description: Enables read load balancing, that means 'get' requests will be distributed  between primary and backup nodes if it is possible and CacheConfiguration.isReadFromBackup() is true.

name: IGNITE_BPLUS_TREE_LOCK_RETRIES
description: Enables read load balancing, that means 'get' requests will be distributed  between primary and backup nodes if it is possible and CacheConfiguration.isReadFromBackup() is true.

name: IGNITE_BPLUS_TREE_DISABLE_METRICS
description: Number of repetitions to capture a lock in the B+Tree

name: IGNITE_FAILURE_HANDLER_RESERVE_BUFFER_SIZE
description: Amount of memory reserved in the heap at node start, which can be dropped  to increase the chances of success when handling OutOfMemoryError

name: IGNITE_PART_DISTRIBUTION_WARN_THRESHOLD
description: The threshold of uneven distribution above which partition distribution  will be logged

name: IGNITE_DISABLE_WAL_DURING_REBALANCING
description: The threshold of uneven distribution above which partition distribution  will be logged

name: IGNITE_DUMP_THREADS_ON_FAILURE_THROTTLING_TIMEOUT
description: Throttling time out for thread dump generation during failure handling  in milliseconds. Default is failure detection timeout. 0 or negative value - throttling is disabled

name: IGNITE_UNWIND_THROTTLING_TIMEOUT
description: Throttling timeout in milliseconds which avoid excessive PendingTree access on  unwind if there is nothing to clean yet

name: IGNITE_THROTTLE_LOG_THRESHOLD
description: Throttling timeout in milliseconds which avoid excessive PendingTree access on  unwind if there is nothing to clean yet

name: IGNITE_EVICTION_PERMITS
description: Number of concurrent operation for evict partitions

name: IGNITE_ALLOW_DML_INSIDE_TRANSACTION
description: Number of concurrent operation for evict partitions

name: IGNITE_ZOOKEEPER_DISCOVERY_RETRY_TIMEOUT
description: Timeout between ZooKeeper client retries in milliseconds

name: IGNITE_ZOOKEEPER_DISCOVERY_MAX_RETRY_COUNT
description: Timeout between ZooKeeper client retries in milliseconds

name: IGNITE_REUSE_MEMORY_ON_DEACTIVATE
description: Number of attempts to reconnect to ZooKeeper

name: IGNITE_SYSTEM_WORKER_BLOCKED_TIMEOUT
description: Maximum inactivity period for system worker in milliseconds. When this  value is exceeded, worker is considered blocked with consequent critical failure handler invocation

name: IGNITE_CHECKPOINT_READ_LOCK_TIMEOUT
description: Maximum inactivity period for system worker in milliseconds. When this  value is exceeded, worker is considered blocked with consequent critical failure handler invocation

name: IGNITE_WAIT_SCHEMA_UPDATE
description: Timeout for checkpoint read lock acquisition in milliseconds

name: IGNITE_REBALANCE_THROTTLE_OVERRIDE
description: Overrides CacheConfiguration.getRebalanceThrottle  configuration property for all caches in milliseconds. 0 by default, which means that override is disabled

name: IGNITE_ALLOW_START_CACHES_IN_PARALLEL
description: Allows to start multiple caches in parallel

name: IGNITE_RECOVERY_VERBOSE_LOGGING
description: Allows to start multiple caches in parallel

name: IGNITE_DEFAULT_DISK_PAGE_COMPRESSION
description: Disk page compression - CacheConfiguration#setDiskPageCompression

name: IGNITE_DEFAULT_DATA_STORAGE_PAGE_SIZE
description: Disk page compression - CacheConfiguration#setDiskPageCompression

name: IGNITE_SQL_MAX_EXTRACTED_PARTS_FROM_BETWEEN
description: Maximum number of different partitions to be extracted from between  expression within sql query. In case of limit exceeding all partitions will be used

name: IGNITE_GLOBAL_METASTORAGE_HISTORY_MAX_BYTES
description: Maximum number of different partitions to be extracted from between  expression within sql query. In case of limit exceeding all partitions will be used

name: IGNITE_AFFINITY_BACKUPS_THRESHOLD
description: Maximum amount of bytes that can be stored in history of DistributedMetaStorage updates

name: IGNITE_RECOVERY_SEMAPHORE_PERMITS

name: IGNITE_NODE_IDS_HISTORY_SIZE
description: Limit the maximum number of objects in memory during the recovery procedure

name: IGNITE_DIAGNOSTIC_WARN_LIMIT
description: Maximum size of history of server nodes (server node IDs) that ever joined  to current topology

name: IGNITE_FAIL_NODE_ON_UNRECOVERABLE_PARTITION_INCONSISTENCY
description: Maximum number of diagnostic warning messages per category, when waiting for PME

description: Forcibly fills missing columns belonging to the primary key with nulls  or default values if those have been specified

name: IGNITE_BASELINE_AUTO_ADJUST_LOG_INTERVAL
description: Forcibly fills missing columns belonging to the primary key with nulls  or default values if those have been specified

name: IGNITE_TX_OWNER_DUMP_REQUESTS_ALLOWED
description: Shows if dump requests from local node to near node are allowed, when  long running transaction is found. If allowed, the compute request to near node will be made to get  thread dump of transaction owner thread

name: IGNITE_PAGE_LOCK_TRACKER_TYPE
description: Page lock tracker type. -1 - Disable lock tracking. 1 - HEAP_STACK.  2 - HEAP_LOG. 3 - OFF_HEAP_STACK. 4 - OFF_HEAP_LOG

name: IGNITE_PAGE_LOCK_TRACKER_CAPACITY
description: Capacity in pages for storing in page lock tracker strucuture

name: IGNITE_PAGE_LOCK_TRACKER_CHECK_INTERVAL
description: Capacity in pages for storing in page lock tracker strucuture

name: IGNITE_DUMP_PAGE_LOCK_ON_FAILURE
description: Page lock tracker thread for checking hangs threads interval

name: IGNITE_LOG_CLASSPATH_CONTENT_ON_STARTUP
description: Enables threads locks dumping on critical node failure

name: IGNITE_LONG_TRANSACTION_TIME_DUMP_THRESHOLD
description: Threshold timeout for long transactions, if transaction exceeds it, it  will be dumped in log with information about how much time did it spent in system time (time while acquiring  locks, preparing, committing, etc) and user time (time when client node runs some code while holding  transaction and not waiting it). Equals 0 if not set. No long transactions are dumped in log if nor  this parameter neither IGNITE_TRANSACTION_TIME_DUMP_SAMPLES_COEFFICIENT is set

name: IGNITE_TRANSACTION_TIME_DUMP_SAMPLES_COEFFICIENT
description: The coefficient for samples of completed transactions that will be dumped  in log. Must be float value between 0.0 and 1.0 inclusive

name: IGNITE_MASTER_KEY_NAME_TO_CHANGE_BEFORE_STARTUP
description: The master key name that the node will use during the recovery. If a node  was unavailable during a master key change process it won't be able to join to cluster with old the  master key. Set up this property to re-encrypt cache keys on startup and join to cluster with the valid  master key name

name: IGNITE_DISABLE_GRP_STATE_LAZY_STORE
description: Disable group state lazy store. It means that group state won't be cached  and will be read from wal every time

name: IGNITE_TCP_COMM_MSG_QUEUE_WARN_SIZE
description: When set to positive number warning will be produced when outgoing message queue size of  TCP communication SPI exeeds provided value. Default is 0 (do not print warning)

name: IGNITE_DUMP_TX_COLLISIONS_INTERVAL
description: When above zero, prints tx key collisions once per interval. Each  transaction besides OPTIMISTIC SERIALIZABLE capture locks on all enlisted keys, for some reasons per key  lock queue may rise. This property sets the interval during which statistics are collected

name: IGNITE_TEST_ENV
description: Set to true only during the junit tests.  Can be used for changing behaviour of tightly coupled code pieces during the tests.  Use it as a last resort only, prefer another toolchain like DI, mocks and etc. if possible

name: IGNITE_DEFRAGMENTATION_REGION_SIZE_PERCENTAGE
description: Defragmentation region size percentage of configured region size.  This percentage will be calculated from largest configured region size and then proportionally subtracted  from all configured regions

name: IGNITE_PERF_STAT_FILE_MAX_SIZE

name: IGNITE_PERF_STAT_BUFFER_SIZE

name: IGNITE_PERF_STAT_FLUSH_SIZE

name: IGNITE_PERF_STAT_CACHED_STRINGS_THRESHOLD

name: IGNITE_CALCITE_EXEC_IN_BUFFER_SIZE

name: IGNITE_CALCITE_EXEC_MODIFY_BATCH_SIZE

name: IGNITE_CALCITE_EXEC_IO_BATCH_SIZE

name: IGNITE_INDEX_REBUILD_BATCH_SIZE

name: IGNITE_THROTTLE_INLINE_SIZE_CALCULATION

name: IGNITE_SNAPSHOT_SEQUENTIAL_WRITE

name: IGNITE_CONFIGURATION_VIEW_PACKAGES
description: Flag to indicate that disk writes during snapshot process should be in a sequential  manner when possible. This generates extra disk space usage

name: IGNITE_MESSAGE_UNMARSHAL_ONCE_CHECK
description: Packages list to expose in configuration view
